description: Source code for a tool that reads and extracts zlib compressed calibration data from AVM Fritz!Box devices, including functions for decompression and error handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, seeks to the calibration entry, and performs decompression.

methods.name: inf
methods.description: Decompresses data from source file to destination file with limit and skip options.

methods.name: zerr
methods.description: Handles and reports zlib or I/O errors based on return codes.

methods.name: get_num
methods.description: Parses a string as a number, supporting hexadecimal and decimal formats.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the tool.
